candidate_workaround: After an overlarge commit-summary response, read only the exact commit head and parent, then prove push and four-way equality with bounded scalar probes.
failure_signature: The evidence commit succeeded, but a combined commit and stat summary exceeded the supervising output budget.
recurrence_guard: Do not request whole-commit file listings when exact head, parent, push, and equality scalars are sufficient.
rollback: Give the truncated summary zero presentation credit; never recommit or repush until exact state is audited.
scope_boundary: Owner-lane evidence-commit recovery only; no content, scientific, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Use scalar commit and equality probes after overlarge summaries
trigger_preconditions: A successful commit wrapper emits an overlarge file listing that truncates its supervising response.
